purpose: Record the exact-starting-commit baseline required by section 11.1 of the controlling prompt, executed entirely on Azure Container Registry build agents, from a real Git checkout retaining .git and .gitignore metadata.

source_binding.checkout_method: git clone over anonymous HTTPS Git transport, then detached checkout at the exact commit, performed on the ACR build agent
source_binding.why_this_matters: Round 5 recorded four false regressions caused by az acr build stripping .git and .gitignore from the uploaded Docker context. Section 11.1 forbids reproducing that harness and forbids weakening tests to accommodate it. No Docker build context was used for the baseline, so .dockerignore never filtered the source, and the tests that call git check-ignore read the committed ignore file.

execution.local_compute_used: none; the laptop submitted the runs and read the returned logs only

runs.purpose: Attempted a stdin task definition against a remote Git context.
runs.outcome: az acr run resolves --file against the cloned context, so a stdin definition is not addressable when a remote context is supplied. No source was built and no test ran.

runs.purpose: Prove that an in-task git clone at the exact commit yields real .git and .gitignore metadata.
runs.outcome: COMMIT and TREE matched the required starting state; .git, .gitignore and evaluator_sets were all present.

runs.purpose: First baseline attempt with an Azure-SDK-only dependency closure.
runs.outcome: 18 collection errors. src/jspace_observation/__init__.py eagerly imports model_loader, which imports torch, so the suite requires the full requirements.txt closure. No test outcome is claimed from this run.

runs.purpose: Baseline with the full requirements.txt closure, executed with the checkout at /workspace/src.
runs.outcome: 2234 passed, 15 skipped, 3 failed in 156.03s. One failure beyond the two disclosed ones; diagnosed in discrepancy_analysis below.

runs.purpose: Baseline re-executed from a path whose name does not contain the substring 'workspace', plus a mechanical diagnosis of the cm1v discrepancy.
runs.outcome: 2235 passed, 15 skipped, 2 failed in 149.46s. The two failures are exactly the disclosed sealed-input environmental failures.

baseline_result.failed_tests_disposition: Preserved as failures, not converted to skips, exactly as section 11.1 requires. They require the git-ignored private sealed inputs, which were not supplied to this cloud task. No registered private synthetic fixture path was provided.
baseline_result.agreement_with_declared_starting_facts: EXACT. The controlling prompt declares the Round 5 final result as 2235 passed / 15 skipped / 2 failed, with the two failures in tests/test_parser_v3_seal_job.py. This baseline reproduces that from the exact starting commit on independent compute.

discrepancy_analysis.assertion: assert 'workspace' not in text, evaluated over the lowercased bytes of 02_records.jsonl, 03_metrics.csv and 06_paper_table.csv from the saturation self-test pack.
discrepancy_analysis.mechanically_established_cause: The self-test writes 00_stage_manifest.json with inputs.corpus_path set to the absolute path of data/jlens_saturation_prompts.jsonl, and that absolute path propagates into the record artifacts. ACR Tasks mount the shared source volume at /workspace, so a checkout at /workspace/src makes every recorded corpus path contain the literal substring 'workspace'. The diagnosis was not inferred: the self-test was re-run under /workspace/src inside cm1w and the emitted artifact was shown to contain the string corpus_path=/workspace/src/data/jlens_saturation_prompts.jsonl.
discrepancy_analysis.classification: Harness artifact of the checkout path, not a code regression and not a property of the commit.
discrepancy_analysis.remedy_applied: The checkout was copied to a neutral path (/tmp/src) and the suite re-run unchanged.
discrepancy_analysis.remedy_explicitly_not_applied: No test was skipped, xfailed, relaxed, renamed, deleted or otherwise weakened, and no source file was edited. Section 11.1 forbids accommodating a damaged harness by changing tests.
discrepancy_analysis.residual_limitation: The test is sensitive to the absolute path of the checkout. That sensitivity is a property of the committed test and is disclosed here; it is not repaired in this round, because repairing it would be an edit made before the Phase A freeze and outside the authorized baseline step.

environment.dependency_source: requirements.txt at the starting commit, plus pytest
environment.dependency_pinning_limitation: requirements.txt is unpinned, so the resolved closure is a property of the resolution date rather than of the commit. The closure actually resolved is recorded below so the run is reproducible by record. Section 11.2 work in Phase A must replace this with a committed lock.

protected_artifact_verification.when: Before any edit in this round.
protected_artifact_verification.digest_convention: LF-normalised SHA-256, matching _lf_digest in the same module
protected_artifact_verification.limitation: This verification was computed locally as a bounded orientation check over twelve small public files. It is not the authoritative check. Section 11.2 requires the protected and frozen raw-byte checks to run in Azure, and Phase A must run them there.

counters_unchanged_by_this_step.note: The baseline is a public build-and-test step. It read no private object and ran no parser against private or locked material.

No private semantic read had occurred at that time, and none has occurred since.

disclosed_deviations.disposition: Recorded, not erased or reclassified. No further subagent or auditor delegation has been performed in this round, and none will be. Formal assessment against the repository's frozen integrity rules is required before the first private semantic read.

disclosed_deviations.what: Section 15 of the controlling prompt directs non-force commits on main. The host application confines this session to a dedicated worktree branch and forbids writing to the main checkout.
disclosed_deviations.disposition: The operator was shown the conflict and explicitly chose to continue on the worktree branch and to decide the merge to main personally. Recorded here so that no reader mistakes the branch of record for main. No commit was force-pushed, amended, reset or rewritten.
